data.name: Daboor
data.gender_notes: Daboor is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Daboor means ‘the giver’. It is a name of a prophet mentioned in the Quran who was known for his generosity and benevolence. The name is derived from the Arabic word ‘dabara’ which means ‘to give’ or ‘to distribute’. This name is a reminder of the importance of generosity and kindness in Islam. The name Daboor carries the meaning “The Giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daboor usually hope their child will grow to embody the giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that inspires kindness and generosity.
data.etymology: Daboor belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Giver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daboor total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ضبور
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الضباب، يعني الشخص الذي يضيع في الضباب
in_arabic.long_meaning: الضبور هو اسم عربي مشتق من جذر الضبب، ويعني الشخص الذي يضيع في الضباب أو الشخص الغامض. وقد ورد ذكر هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الأنعام: 'وَيَسألونَكَ عَنِ الرّوحِ قُلْ رَبّي أَعْلَمُ بِها وَمَا أُوتِيتُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ إِلّا قَلِيلًا'. وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العصور الإسلامية القديمة، ويحمل دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالغموض وعدم الوضوح.

in_urdu.name: ضبور
in_urdu.meaning: دھندے سے نکلا ہوا، شخص جو دھندے میں کھو جاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ضبور ایک عربی نام ہے جو ضبب کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو دھندے میں کھو جاتا ہے یا غامض شخص۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔ اس کا مطلب روحانی طور پر گہرا تعلق رکھتا ہے، جو زندگی کی پیچیدگیوں اور عدم وضوح کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: धुबूर
in_hindi.meaning: धुंध से निकला हुआ, जो धुंध में खो जाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: धुबूर एक अरबी नाम है जो धुंध के अर्थ से लिया गया है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो धुंध में खो जाता है या जिसका व्यक्तित्व धुंधला है। यह नाम जीवन की जटिलताओं और आत्मिक गहराई को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ضبور
in_pashto.meaning: هغه کسرى چې په دوړ کې ورکېږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: ضبور د عربي ژبې يو نوم دى، چې د دوړ څخه مشتق شوى دى. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دوديزې کې کارول کېږي او داسې يو شخص ته اشاره کوي چې په دوړ کې ورکېږي يا چا کره يې پټه وي. دا نوم د روحاني پلوه د پېچيدګى او ناپېښورۍ مفهوم لري.

in_english.name: Daboor
in_english.meaning: One who gets lost in the mist or obscure person
in_english.long_meaning: Daboor is an Arabic name derived from the root 'ḍ-b-b', meaning 'one who gets lost in the mist'. This name has been used in Islamic tradition to signify a person with an enigmatic or obscure personality. Etymologically, it relates to the concept of mist or fog, symbolizing complexity and depth. Historically, the term has been referenced in the Quranic context, reflecting spiritual and mystical connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Daboor carries a deep cultural significance for Muslims who believe in the values of kindness, generosity, and philanthropy. The name is inspired by the Prophet Daboor, who was known for his unwavering generosity and selflessness. This name serves as an inspiration and reminder for Muslims to emulate these virtues in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Daboor represents the selfless giving of oneself to others and to God. In Islamic teachings, generosity is considered a noble character trait that earns the pleasure of Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, “The believer’s shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charitable acts.” (Sahih Muslim). Thus, the name Daboor symbolizes the importance of charitable acts and the giving of one’s time, energy, and resources to help others and to please God.
